secao: Lecture II: A Candle: Brightness Of The Flame—Air Necessary For Combustion—Production Of Water.
titulo: Lecture II: A Candle: Brightness Of The Flame—Air Necessary For Combustion—Production Of Water.
textoOriginal: And you see from this that there are clearly two different kinds of action—one the production of the vapour, and the other the combustion of it—both of which take place in particular parts of the candle.
